observation.ranges: 24 evenly spaced body-frame rays, starting forward, counterclockwise; range/max_range; nearest wall, static obstacle or peer surface
observation.peers: 3 nearest peers sorted by distance then robot index; each slot: body-frame relative x/5, y/5, vx/2, vy/2, presence; pad absent slots with zeros
observation.normalization: fixed physical scales above; do not fit on validation/test; document any additional train-only normalization

collision_rule: first static/wall/peer contact terminates team episode; simultaneous update and per-substep collision checks required
goal_rule: finished robots stop and remain obstacles; success requires all robots arrived without collision; horizon is truncation
selection: team success first; differences below 5 percentage points are practically tied subject to uncertainty; then capped completion, inference cost, training cost

compute_budget.policy: stop at first sample/epoch or total wall limit; include demonstrations and tuning; reduce scope and disclose if needed
